name: anvil-engineering-workbench
description: Deterministic local code intelligence, architecture mapping, change risk analysis, and quality/security gating for AI coding assistants.

tools.name: anvil_inspect_project
tools.description: Inspect project structure, languages, frameworks, package managers, scripts, and dependencies. Call first when onboarding or checking stack.

tools.name: anvil_map_architecture
tools.description: Map project architecture, entry points, module relationships, and external dependencies before modifying core architecture.

tools.name: anvil_change_risk
tools.description: Analyze blast radius, downstream dependency impact, structural complexity, and suggested test targets for git changes.

tools.name: anvil_git_intelligence
tools.description: Inspect working-tree git diff, uncommitted changes, affected modules, and heuristic commit risk.

tools.name: anvil_quality_audit
tools.description: Fast static quality audit across manifests, test structure, security patterns, and workflow health.

tools.name: anvil_security_audit
tools.description: Deep scan for hardcoded secrets, API keys, sensitive tokens, and dangerous script patterns.

tools.name: anvil_clean_preview
tools.description: Preview safe cleanup of junk files, build caches, temp files, and unused orphan source files.

tools.name: anvil_search_code
tools.description: Search identifiers, functions, and text across project source code within workspace security boundaries.

tools.name: anvil_list_files
tools.description: List workspace source and config files (bounded to 200 entries, excludes .git, node_modules, secrets).

tools.name: anvil_read_file
tools.description: Read workspace source/config file with security guardrails (rejects files >128 KiB, traversal, secrets).

tools.name: anvil_project_health
tools.description: Generate a unified 0-100 project health score and grade (A-F) combining tooling, architecture, and quality.

tools.name: anvil_doctor
tools.description: Run diagnostic system and workspace health checks on Node runtime, Git, Docker, and permissions.
